mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_participant (group_buy_id, member_id, pre_order_id, joined_at) values (#{groupBuyId}, #{memberId}, #{preOrderId}, #{joinedAt})
mapper.select: select gbp.member_id, m.name as member_name, gbp.joined_at from group_buy_participant gbp inner join member m on gbp.member_id = m.id where gbp.group_buy_id = #{groupBuyId} order by gbp.joined_at asc
